in_sanskrit.name: Jittu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little, Small
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jittu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Jittu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jita', meaning 'victorious' or 'conqueror'. It is a diminutive form of Jit, and is often used as a nickname or term of endearment. In Hindu mythology, Jittu is associated with the god Vishnu and his avatar Krishna, who are revered for their strength and courage.
